description: This file defines the CopyProjectActivityAPI class, an API endpoint for copying activities between projects in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes methods for listing copyable activities, copying selected activities, and validation rules, utilizing various internal services and models.

classes.name: CopyProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for copying project activities between projects in OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of copyable activities between two projects, including duplicate activities count and total activity count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Copies selected activities from one project to another, handling duplicates and validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing copyable activities, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for copying activities, primarily validating activity IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation, not implemented.

methods.name: getCommonURLValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common URL validation rules for project IDs.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts project IDs from the URL parameters.
